meta.notes: Bars that join each other, walls and solid blocks, as iron bars do. Mined with a stone pickaxe or better, as copper. Tin Bars: on random ticks it slowly ages into the exposed stage, msm_starter:exposed_tin_bars, by copper's own chance, and a lower-stage neighbour holds it back. Honeycomb waxes it into msm_starter:waxed_tin_bars.
